dashboards.purpose: Own dashboards feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the insights context.
dashboards.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide reusable runtime-support assets shared by insights-owned features and composition seams.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes context-local composition that should not duplicate across features.
runtime-support.createdFor: insights workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

routes.purpose: Expose insights-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
